rules: No current autonomous mechanism is presumed permanent.
Every scaffold must compensate for a named current capability or operational gap.
Every scaffold must stay detachable and declare dependencies plus a detachment condition.
When native model/tool capability provides equal or better outcomes, prefer removing or replacing the scaffold.
Current required scaffolds remain mandatory until an explicit framework contract change removes them.
For player-facing autonomous work, immutable candidate After observation and bounded repair/re-stage select the source before the single merge-owning exact-head validation is armed.

modules.compensatesFor: Current models can anchor on easy-to-find source defects before establishing the real player-facing problem.
modules.detachWhen: A model-native workflow reliably grounds improvement selection in the live player experience without forced observation ordering.

modules.compensatesFor: Current models often collapse an experience problem into one convenient micro-fix or pad scope with unrelated edits.
modules.detachWhen: Model-native planning consistently chooses coherent experience-sized scope without minimum work-item rules.

modules.compensatesFor: Current autonomous runs need explicit hypotheses, falsifiers, scope, and evidence mapping to avoid untraceable changes and repeated failed ideas.
modules.detachWhen: The model/runtime maintains equivalent causal memory and decision traceability natively without repository experiment records.

modules.compensatesFor: Current implementation models can introduce causal regressions that are cheaper to detect with targeted executable assertions.
modules.detachWhen: Model-native or direct runtime evaluation establishes changed behavior and regression safety at equal or better reliability without separate tests.

modules.compensatesFor: Current chat/tool execution cannot be assumed to validate the exact repository head in a reproducible hosted environment.
modules.detachWhen: The execution model natively provides trustworthy exact-source execution and validation receipts without a separate hosted CI pass.

modules.compensatesFor: Mutable DEV surfaces can drift between observation and evaluation, breaking causal identity.
modules.detachWhen: The model/runtime observes and evaluates a source-addressed game state natively so mutable deployment identity cannot contaminate evidence.

modules.compensatesFor: Current code/test success does not reliably establish the resulting player-facing experience for visual and interactive changes.
modules.detachWhen: The model/runtime directly perceives and judges the resulting player experience with sufficient reliability as part of implementation itself.

modules.compensatesFor: Current sessions are ephemeral and can repeat failed approaches or lose validated outcome provenance.
modules.detachWhen: Long-lived model/runtime memory and repository state provide equivalent reliable learning/provenance without explicit receipts or experiment history.

modules.compensatesFor: Current external observers need explicit progress state because autonomous execution is opaque and sessions can stop unexpectedly.
modules.detachWhen: Execution progress and recovery state are natively observable and durable without repository/chat telemetry records.

modules.compensatesFor: Concurrent repository changes can invalidate a previously validated head or overlap its affected scope.
modules.detachWhen: The model/repository runtime natively maintains transactional source consistency across concurrent changes without explicit freshness choreography.
